answer: The wall is Endorsed change ringer method file with change ringers confirmation. Each brick is three-year ringing, 400 supervised changes, theory exam, annual fees, laid by a different hand, in a different year. One honest agent risks 107 POA once; a farm of 504 risks 53928 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. Judge it by the relic: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the meadow: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the violet: a file that outlives the farm.
